title: Sfera Tag Scanner
shortSummary: Inspect clothing references, track inventory entries and exits, and review stock history.
problem: Inspect clothing references, track inventory entries and exits, and review stock history.
architecture: Native Kotlin rules preserve leading zeros. Room transactions keep stock and movements consistent. The browser demo simulates the workflow with sample data.
outcome: Four JVM and three instrumentation tests passed on the Android emulator, including Room rollback and ML Kit OCR on a synthetic bitmap. Physical camera and RFID workflows remain unverified.
decisions: Native Kotlin rules preserve leading zeros. Room transactions keep stock and movements consistent. The browser demo simulates the workflow with sample data.
